name: nexus_oauth_refresh
description:
Force a refresh of the OAuth access token via the refresh grant. Call it when a request returns 401.

A 4xx refresh failure means the user revoked the application (see
https://users.nexusmods.com/oauth/authorized_applications) and the stored
tokens are cleared - log in again with nexus_oauth_login.

Returns:
    JSON {refreshed, expires_at, scope} or an error string.
